The complaint was filed in the U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Florida.Roughly 1,600 customers contributed at least $397 million to the scheme, while Delgado and Goliath misappropriated all customer funds. news.title_ru: Стратегия Готовы купить биткойны? Сэйлор выпустила свежий тизер фильма «Ведение бизнеса»
